item.title: 'We Need You Here' — Maplewood to Celebrate Transgender Day of Visibility March 26 - The Village Green
item.description: "To all the young people out there, please know that you are not alone," said Cuttle. "You are loved. You belong here. You matter. We need you here. We need you here in the fight moving forward." - Former South Orange-Maplewood Board of Education 1st Vice President Shannon Cuttle

item.title: South Orange Neighbors Rally to Support Homeowner & Her Dogs After House Fire - The Village Green
item.description: South Essex FD and mutual aid operated on scene at the Melrose Place home for nearly 3 hours, "conducting fire suppression, primary and secondary searches, and extensive overhaul operations."

item.title: Martin Ceperley Announces Campaign for Maplewood Township Committee - The Village Green
item.description: Ceperley joins Mayor Vic De Luca and Planning Board member John Sullivan in a now contested Democratic primary. Two seats are up for election on the Township Committee.

item.title: Facing Budget Crunch, South Orange-Maplewood Schools to Cut Pre-K Courtesy Busing - The Village Green
item.description: "For the past year, I have been warning of the 'fiscal cliff' that is coming to our district and many others in the state. Rising costs are far outpacing expected revenue, and our only path forward to deliver a balanced budget is with responsible adjustments to spending." — Supt. Jason Bing

item.title: South Orange Village Proclaims March 31 as Transgender Visibility Day - The Village Green
item.description: In passing the proclamation, the Council encouraged “all residents to celebrate the lives and contributions of transgender and non-binary people, stand against discrimination and misinformation, and work together to ensure that every member of our community can live openly, safely, and with dignity.”

item.title: 1st Cohort of CHS Students Graduate From NJ CAR’s 18-Week Technician Advancement Program - The Village Green
item.description: The bootcamp is unique in providing the necessary qualifications needed to become an entry-level technician in a considerably shorter timeframe than usual.

item.title: UPDATE: Residents Express Privacy Concerns As School District Implements Visitor Screening Software - The Village Green
item.description: Director of Safety Paul Morgan said that the Raptor visitor management system would not launch "until we have all of our ducks in a row. ...We're working with their legal department to ensure that our privacy is kept at really high standard."

item.title: Mayor De Luca Files to Run for 10th Term on Maplewood Township Committee - The Village Green
item.description: De Luca will be running in a contested primary with SOMA Bike Bus dad Martin Ceperley and Planning Board member John Sullivan. Two seats are up for election. Primary day is June 2.
